refinement_plan_1.analysis: Review feedback identifies several improvement areas, with high priority on (1) introducing OWL restrictions (cardinality, value constraints) on key properties (hasInvoiceLineItem, hasOrganizationRoleAssignment, hasIdentifier, etc.) to enforce EDIFACT/D96A cardinality and completeness rules, and (2) adding code list/value set classes and individuals for EDIFACT segment and data element codes (e.g., BGM, NAD, DTM). Medium priorities are (3) defining GCAs and equivalence axioms for key classes (e.g., InvoiceMessage ≡ EdifactMessage and hasSegment some HeaderSection and ...), and (4) modeling temporal/contextual attributes (e.g., effective dates for role assignments, invoice issue/due dates) using xsd:dateTime. Low priority: (5) add object properties for segment delimiters and parsing rules, and improve EDIFACT reference comments. There are no missing CQs or constraint violations. Plan: (1) Add OWL restrictions (minCardinality, allValuesFrom/someValuesFrom as appropriate) to key properties; (2) introduce code list/value set classes and individuals for segments and data elements (BGM, NAD, DTM, etc.); (3) define at least one GCA/equivalence axiom for InvoiceMessage and possibly others; (4) add temporal/contextual data properties (e.g., effectiveFrom, effectiveTo, issueDate, dueDate); (5) add segment delimiter properties and richer comments if time allows. Will preserve all correct elements and annotations.
